head.method: Rendered head vertices inside the fixed GI mesh

limitations: Control values are solved on an illustrative tract, not measured from a patient.
Nominal clinical multiplane angles are attempted first; only the stated view-family interval is permitted as a fallback.
Coverage uses a central geometric target cross; actual chamber/valve coverage requires source-pixel inspection.
